title: Demonstrate the accounting for an error correction

items.concept: Initial recognition of prior-period adjustment JEs for material errors; subsequent incorrect-vs-correct schedule; period-end adjusting JEs; settlement of previously unrecorded liability
Number-variant twin — initial PPA recognition JEs, cumulative schedule, period-end adjusting JEs after correction
Counterbalancing inventory errors — income-effect schedule; JE only if discovered before self-correction; restatement even when no JE after self-correction
Classification — error correction (PPA/restatement) vs change in estimate (prospective) vs change in principle (retrospective)
Classification of error-correction mechanics — counterbalancing after self-correction; restatement without JE
